mentions.name: Vicena.ai
mentions.description: AI for Science platform that lets users design, simulate and test new battery chemistries, new drugs, and other science with the same ease as building software with coding agents. It connects to scientific compute and a network of labs so science can be done end-to-end from a computer.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Vicena.ai allows you to design, simulate and test new battery chemistries, new drugs… With the same ease as building software with coding agents.

It is an AI for Science connected to scientific compute and a network of labs, so you can do science end-to-end from your computer.
mentions.author: oersted
